paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yalkut, Kohelet, remez 966. But the statement is cited in Kohelet Rabbah, chapter 1, on “A generation goes,” and there it is attributed to Rabbi Berekhyah.[^1]

notes.text: Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 966, whole paragraph 4, fully names Rabbi Huna bar Kahana for the kiln comparison; Kohelet Rabbah 1:4, whole paragraph 1, attributes that comparison to Rabbi Berekhyah. Hyman’s fully written Rav in the heading remains. The supplied locator fragment פ״א ] פסיק is retained literally and is not a repaired numbering claim.
